insights.insight: Cumulative verified GMV stands at $4.86M across 101,229 cryptographically confirmed receipts, with the $5M threshold approximately 10–12 days out at the current ~$13,700/day pace — a concrete scale marker for a network built on deterministic purchase proof, not probabilistic inference.

Seven-day GMV has not broken $100K in any confirmed snapshot period, a pattern consistent enough to indicate a hard ceiling on current weekly throughput rather than random variance — brands evaluating reach should size expectations accordingly.

insights.topic: Velocity below 1x, acceleration above 1x — recovery, not stall
insights.insight: Token velocity is running at 0.591x week-over-week, meaning the network is growing slower than its prior baseline, but the acceleration coefficient of 1.024x confirms the growth rate itself is compounding upward — the system is in recovery mode with momentum building.

The protocol pays ~132 sats (~$0.10) per verified receipt and has settled 809 Lightning payouts to date — each receipt represents a confirmed transaction event, not a behavioral inference, which is the foundational gap between this data type and conventional cookieless targeting proxies.

insights.topic: Geographic coverage is wide but static
insights.insight: Aggregate purchase data is visible across 20 CBSA metro cells with zero new cells added this period, signaling broad but currently plateaued geographic footprint — useful for national brand planning, but local market expansion is not accelerating right now.

insights.topic: The silo vulnerability is real and compounding
insights.insight: The protocol ingests receipts without requiring brand cooperation, meaning aggregate commerce intelligence accumulates across the network regardless of whether any individual brand participates — companies that delay engagement are ceding visibility into market-level purchase behavior to those who don't.
